statements.quote: While TeraWulf historically operated bitcoin mining facilities and leveraged flexible compute loads to support early infrastructure development, going forward the Company’s capital allocation, development activities, and operating focus are centered on HPC data center development, long-term hosting arrangements, and infrastructure supporting AI-driven compute workloads.
statements.notes: Says capital allocation going forward is centered on HPC data centers and infrastructure for AI-driven compute. No amount or share is given. 'Capital allocation' is read as capex. 'Going forward' names no year, so fiscal_year is null.

statements.quote: As contracted HPC capacity is delivered and energized under existing hosting arrangements, management expects the Company’s revenue mix to continue shifting toward HPC leasing and away from legacy bitcoin mining operations.
statements.notes: Seller-side revenue from data-center (HPC) leasing. The sentence does not say AI explicitly, but elsewhere the filing describes the HPC campuses as serving AI-driven compute. No amount or share is stated.
